IFCI Shares Decline Amid NSE IPO Speculation

IFCI shares experienced a significant drop, falling approximately 7-8% on Tuesday. This decline followed a substantial rally where the stock had surged nearly 30% over the preceding month. The recent market activity and share price fluctuations are linked to speculation surrounding the Initial Public Offering (IPO) of the National Stock Exchange (NSE). IFCI holds an indirect interest in the NSE through its stake in Stock Holding Corporation of India.
